description:
**TSP doubled-tree shortcut followed by 2-opt descent.** Use a symmetric complete distance matrix. Kruskal supplies a spanning tree whose edges pass to a preorder traversal. First visits shortcut the closed walk of the doubled tree.

Take that complete order as the initial tour for 2-opt. It minimizes distance within its improving neighborhood while retaining all vertices. The initial guarantee relies on metric costs. The search never intentionally accepts a longer move.

The doubled-tree mechanism creates the Euler structure by duplicating tree edges. The case adds a local refinement phase rather than a matching-based parity correction.
